interpretation_limits: Per-access latency includes SHA-256 validation of the full page.
Warm state inherits Linux cache state from prior processes and is observational, not controlled to an exact residency ratio.
Cgroup memory metrics cover the whole Codespace cgroup, not only the benchmark process.
Logical memory budget is configuration metadata, not a kernel-enforced hard limit.

cache_evidence.limitation: Linux exposes residency and physical read deltas, not an exact per-access page-cache hit counter.

metrics.cpu_average_basis: process CPU time during measured loop; includes checksum validation
metrics.cpu_max_limitation: sampled process peak includes telemetry-thread overhead
